$comment: On-device AI models for the Snapdragon AI Lab Build & Present Challenge. All entries reference models published on Qualcomm AI Hub (https://aihub.qualcomm.com), pre-quantized and NPU-compiled for Snapdragon X Elite / X2 Elite platforms (HP Omnibook Ultra / Omnibook 3).

synthesis.name: Llama-v3.2-3B-Instruct
synthesis.runtime: ONNX Runtime GenAI (og-runtimes) with QNN execution provider (QNN_HTP)
synthesis.role: On-device explanatory synthesis. Replaces the remote Gemini/Groq/HF chain for the offline path: generates the cited, structured research answer entirely on the NPU.
synthesis.notes: A SSD (Self Speculative Decoding) variant 'llama_v3_2_3b_instruct_ssd' exists for faster token generation on supported devices with identical output accuracy.

fallback_synthesis.name: Llama-v3.2-1B-Instruct
fallback_synthesis.runtime: ONNX Runtime GenAI with QNN execution provider
fallback_synthesis.role: Lower-memory fallback when evidence context is short or memory pressure is high.

embeddings.name: All-MiniLM-L6-v2
embeddings.aihub_id: mobilenet alternative; see aihub embeddings list
embeddings.runtime: ONNX Runtime with QNN execution provider (QNN_HTP)
embeddings.role: On-device evidence reranking. Embeds the query and each retrieved passage locally; replaces lexical ranking with semantic similarity so the whole evidence-scoring stage runs on the NPU without any network call.

primary.provider: QNN_HTP (Qualcomm AI Runtime, Hexagon Tensor Processor)
primary.via: onnxruntime / onnxruntime-genai Python or JavaScript bindings
primary.target: Windows 11 on Snapdragon (ARM64), HP Omnibook Ultra / Omnibook 3

development_fallback.target: any x86/ARM64 dev machine; used only when QNN is unavailable, results identical, speed lower
